title: short french tips
text:
UPDATE BELOW.....I purchased these because I in this time of virus, no one (smart people that is) is getting mani/pedis right now. Additionally, you have to ask yourself - that also means you aren't being seen that much either.. But on occasion - I do really mourn my beautiful nails...So... I am trying to do whatever I can. I've had a french tip manicure every 2 weeks for over 20 years. It has been a very rough 6 months. With no hope in sight for a reasonably safe mani/pedi - I've decided to try a few things on my own. This is one of them. The tips are nice. The flower tip to hold onto while you apply it is useful. Then clip the flower tip off and file. The white tips themselves are not very thick, so I you are able to apply a nice, thick coat of clear over the top and you do not have to deal with the dip, gel, or acrylic powder. Which I am very happy about. I use OPI for soft and thin nails. It's clear and thick. 2 coats do it. Works like a dream. The white tips are short, so they grow out easily and you can reapply - or save for special occasions. In fairness, I also purchased tape guides and white polish too. Either works, but I think these tips look a bit better - just in the perfect moon shape. You will need some good nail glue. I purchased a type with a brush applicator. Good for the non-professional. Look, it's not perfect, but until we can safely get back to our salons - this will work for the rare time someone may actually see you OR you just want to feel better for a few days. Having said all of this, I was very disappointed to receive a set with a broken case. So it will not close. I have to rubber band it so they don't all fall out in the drawer. Eh. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE 2/27/2022 I still LOVE these. Easy to use. And a good option to salon nails. Who knew it would be 2+ years (out of salons) - but I have come to just get used to a new normal. I really love not doing the gel/acrylic any more. If I didn't have these tips - I'm not sure.. Easy to use, flexible when applying, last well. I gave up on the polish/curved tapes. These are just simply better.

text:
There are eight large claw clips in this package. The clips come in autumn colors of black and browns and are sturdy. text:
This has an intense musky floral fragrance. I like it. The cap has an extension stick that can be used to apply this to the neck and wrists.

The current price of $23.95 is competitively priced. I do wish it came with a label or ingredients list. Although the satchel is nice, this is not giftable without it being fully labeled in a box. title: Thin hair towel and thin exfoliating glove; functional but not high quality - 2.5 stars
text:
I am not impressed by this towel and glove. These items are functional but they are not the best quality.

The towel is large and thin. It has a button and small cloth loop at the tail that allows me to twist the turban and then secure the excess to the back button. However, since this is large, there is a little play in the turban and it is not as tight as I would like. It is absorbent, however.

The exfoliating glove is scratchy, or a bit rough, and very thin. This also works but it is not high quality.

Overall, I am not impressed by this set. They are functional and work as designed, so in that sense they are okay. I personally consider [[ASIN:B09VL1JQGF these]] Poday towels exceptional compared to this--of course, those do not come with an exfoliating glove but then one gets two towels for almost the same price minus the glove. The current price of $9.99 is insane for this.

title: Decent facial razor; does the job it is supposed to do; cable is short
text:
This is a decent facial razor. It comes with the razor unit itself, a micro-USB cable (A/C adapter NOT included), a cleaning brush, and a user pamphlet.

I charged the razor for about one hour before first use as it was already partially charged. Once the blue lights stopped blinking, this was ready to use. All I had to do was press the power button on the front. I shaved my chin, under my lips, and the sides of my cheeks and it did an excellent job without pinching me.

When I was done, I unscrewed the tiny circular top and blew out the hairs as well as brushed them out with the provided cleaning brush. I really like this razor and I love the electric blue color. I do wish the USB cable was longer and the razor body was a bit thinner, however. Most razors of this type are a bit shorter and thinner.

The current price of $9.99 is reasonable for this. Note that not everyone is going to love a razor like this. I already have several and love them. They do a good job for removing small facial hairs between shaves, which is what I use them for.

title: Lasted me 12 hours until my next shower; surprisingly effective; nice fresh scent
text:
I usually use nothing but Old Spice Swagger solid with the active ingredient of aluminum zirconium tetrachlorohydrex gly 17%. This Schmidt's solid has no aluminum and only natural ingredients. Usually, products like these only last me about 2-3 hours; however, the protection lasted 12 hours until my next shower. Of course, it is winter, so that might be why.

I take a shower every 12 hours because I sweat a lot, so I can never attest to 48-hour protection. This has a fresh cucumber scent. I would not say it is cucumber but it is lovely. I really love the scent.

This works better than other non-aluminum deodorants I tried previously. The current price of $31.13 comes to an expensive $7.78 per 2.65 ounce solid stick as this is a 4-pack. I would never purchase this due to the high price. However, if the price were more in line with my aluminum deodorant, I would consider it.

title: Bulky mesh puffs whose puffiest section creates copious suds
text:
Mesh buff puffs are the only thing I use in the shower besides a back brush. I love them because they generate a lot of suds and they provide good coverage during showering. The full mesh area is similar to the ones I buy except these have an extra section or sections to look like a Christmas tree and snowman.

The Christmas tree loofah is actually a stretchy back puff. The other one is the regular puff. Both work but they are a bit bulky to use. I like the snowman one the best because I can use the top part as a handle while washing with the lower puff. After trying these, this is okay but not ones I would ever order again.

The current price of $8.59 comes to an expensive $4.30 each puff.

text:
I tried several of their other fragrances and find them hit or miss. text:

I have no idea how much these will cost. I love them in every way, including the light that is a surprise inside. The major problem is that they disintegrate immediately and create a mess. title: "Single session" paraffin bath that requires wax to be remelted after each "keep warm" period
text:
I have been using paraffin wax thermotherapy for 25+ years. I originally owned a Holmes bath (I believe that was the brand name but am not certain) and it died after about 10 years of use. I then purchased a [[ASIN:B004QY719E Therabath Professional Paraffin Bath]] that I absolutely love. However, I decided I wanted a backup to my Therabath and also wanted to see how this Lavany bath compares.

The package includes (see first photo)
- 1 brush for applying the paraffin wax, if desired
- 4 x 200g (about 1-3/4 pound) paraffin wax slabs - I love that this arrived flat.
- 2 thermal mitt
- 1 heat insulating grid (goes inside on bottom of tub)
- 50 plastic glove liners
- 1 tiny and instruction pamphlet

LIKES:
- The paraffin wax are in flat slabs, so there is no breaking needed. I just inserted this into the tub and put the cover on.

- The paraffin wax smells nice.

- It is easy to set everything up. Just insert the plastic insulating grid on bottom of tub and plug in. Make sure the on/off switch is in the ON. position

- The bath's cover has a notch in it that allows me to easily remove it with the finger-hold provided.

- The on/off switch on the side has a protective cover; this is good if using waxed fingers to manipulate.

- The wax melts quickly in around 30 minutes.

DISLIKES:
- Setting the keep warm temperature was utterly confusing and not without some trial and error. The instruction book is not very clear.

- The unit is loud; I thought I heard a fan going the two different times I used it.

- The keep warm temperature can only be set once per session. I could not get the buttons to work after I set it in each session.

-There is not enough wax; it only covers 1/4 of the tub (see second photo). Of course, I could buy more but the instruction pamphlet does not say if there is a fill limit. Also, it would increase the melting time.

- The tub is a bit small to insert a full hand; its more like for child hands. Now if there were more wax, it would be easier to cover both hands, but as delivered, I had to use the opposing hand to "splash" wax onto both sides of the other hand and vice versa. I could have used the brush, but preferred not to.

- MY BIGGEST DISAPPOINTMENT is that this bath does not stay on. The unit has a selection of keep warm temperatures between 127 and 143 F and a keep warm timer function. However, after setting the temperature and then the timer, the unit turns off when the time is over. Keep warm is a maximum of 180 minutes (3 hours). Most paraffin baths are designed to stay on permanently and cycle on and off to keep the temperature steady. I have kept my paraffin baths on for six months straight (usually in part of the spring and fall and all of the winter).

Once the bath is plugged in, the LED cycles through some temperatures (probably heating temperature, etc.) and other stuff that is unclear as the manual does not describe what those numbers and symbols are. However, to set the keep warm paraffin wax temperature:
- Hold down the + sign until the F symbol blinks
- Once it does, use either the "+" or "-" to set the desired temperature anywhere between 127 and 143 F. '
- Wait a few seconds until the F symbol is steady.
- Once it is no longer flickering, press and hold the "-" symbol until the MIN symbol blinks.
- Once it blinks, use the "+" or "-" to set it to the desired keep warm time. For instance, if I wanted to keep warm for 30 minutes, I would press either the "+" or "-" until it went up or down to 30 minutes. The timer skips in 5-minute increments.
- The keep warm temperature and keep warm timer are now set. Once the wax melts, the keep warm timer will come on.
- The unit will turn off after the keep warm timer runs out. It stays off permanently, even if it's plugged in and switched on. I left mine on over night and it never came on again. The manual does not provide this information.
- If I want to use the bath a second time, I have to go through the entire process all over again. It does remember the last settings, however, so nothing has to be reset if the desired keep warm temperature and desired keep warm time are suitable. However, the wax has to be melted each time.

Despite the negatives, I gave this 3 stars because there are some cases where I only want to use the bath once in a while. In that case, this is an okay design. However, I personally would not purchase a bath like this because several years ago I used a paraffin bath several times a day due to hand numbness problems and I needed the bath to be ready the moment I experienced numbness. If you need the wax to be ready at a moments notice, several times per day, or daily, then do not purchase this bath. However, if you only want to use a paraffin bath once in a while, then this might be an acceptable alternative because the tiny amount of wax melts quickly and the unit does not stay on all day using up electricity.

title: When something’s too good to be true.. Hmm?!
text:

On the positive side- hairs left feeling soft and silky with a healthy shine. I do appreciate this aspect and find it leaves hair feeling soft and dairy see manageable with flyaways. title: Hardest working deodorant Ive found in a long time!!

Application is rather smooth but, does necessitate 2-3 swipes- If needed.. I also found, a touch up goes on just as smooth, if you’re heading out for the night… and can confidently last through to the next day! There’s no clumping or pilling of product noticed when in use.. Ha!
Using with multiple color fabrics has not been an issue with residue.. and that includes an all black soccer game uniform- this has yet to leave any staining on the fabric, bonus!

Being of pure Icelandic descent- to say we have sensitive skin is an understatement. This uses natural ingredients and has paid special attention to leaving out harsh chemicals- keeps it from adding irritants. So far, adverse reaction.

For a 3 bundle- it is a higher price point at $18.. but, you’re paying more for better quality return. Overall, the Hardest working deodorant I found in a long time!

It smells strongly of coconut and the fragrance transfers when you wash with it. After a good shower with this body wash I feel clean; that is, I didn’t notice it leaving a film behind like some soaps do.

This is marketed as an exfoliating soap but I didn’t feel anything in the soap that feels remotely abrasive enough like most exfoliating washes so I am not convinced of the claim that it will exfoliate on its own without scrubbing sponge or cloth. Where this body wash excels, however, is as a moisturizer. After a shower I noticed that my normally dry skin was softer and less dry. Maybe that’s what was meant by exfoliating?

It does work well as a hand soap – if you like coconut-scented hand soap. At least two of these bottles will end up being used for just washing hands.
